candidates.name: Notice 19: Electronic Document Registration Service through Business Gateway
verified_facts: Business Gateway is HM Land Registry's XML machine-to-machine interface for electronic registration services.
The notice defines development schemes and the digital submission framework used by subscribers.
semantic_limits: Machine-readable submission and schema conformance do not certify parcel geometry, exact boundaries or elevation measurements.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: HM Land Registry's plans page indexes the Practice Guide 40 supplements and Practice Guide 41 surveying guidance.
The page separates plan basis, application plans, boundaries, determined boundaries, title plans and plan-related services into distinct guidance routes.
semantic_limits: A guidance index establishes source hierarchy only; it is not parcel-specific geometry or elevation evidence.
